reader.notes: The specification exists in docs/conformance/7/DOC-A.1-195.md (no physical alignment, no implicit FILLER, external format identical) and the probe's file shows it is followed. The doc row cites the 2023 clause numbers; it states the same determination holds in every edition (DOC-A.1-197), which covers 1985's implementor-defined list item (21).

refuter.evidence: GR8 requires the implementor to specify (a) external-media format and (b) implicit FILLER. docs/conformance/7/DOC-A.1-195.md specifies both (format byte-identical to the unsynchronized record; no FILLER generated) and lists 1985 witnesses (VI.5.13@1985 g85_bf04_02, g85_bf12_02); DOC-A.1-197 says the determination is the same in every edition. Measured: r3sync.cob group G1 with three SYNC items (SYNC RIGHT sign-separate, SYNC LEFT COMP) is 11 bytes = sum of item sizes, and an ODO table occurrence carries no per-occurrence FILLER (GR7b vacuous); the reader's file probe shows a 10-byte record. One weakness noted, not decisive: the doc cells cite §2023 clause numbers only, but the determination is edition-independent and the 1985 rule asks only that it be specified and followed. cite.py: OK §1985:VI.5.13.4 GR8 (the text is in GR8).
